meta.name: setup
meta.description: Run initial NanoClaw setup. Use when user wants to install NanoClaw, configure it, or go through first-time setup. Triggers on "setup", "install", "configure nanoclaw", or first-time setup requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw 的首次安装与配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接触 NanoClaw 需要初始化设置
copy.tagline_en: Complete initial setup and configuration of NanoClaw
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to NanoClaw and need to initialize it

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会引导你在终端运行 `bash nanoclaw.sh`,该脚本完整安装并配置 NanoClaw(依赖、容器镜像、OneCLI 保险库、Anthropic 凭证、服务、首个 agent 及可选渠道)。出错时它会借助 Claude 自动恢复并从中断处继续。
howto.when: 当你说“setup”“install”或“configure nanoclaw”等关键词,或提出首次安装/配置 NanoClaw 的需求时触发。

say.text: 我要做 NanoClaw 的首次配置
say.note: Claude 会引导你执行安装脚本

say.text: 运行 setup 完成 NanoClaw 安装
say.note: 直接触发 setup 技能

howto.what_en: Claude instructs you to run `bash nanoclaw.sh`. The script handles full NanoClaw setup: dependencies, container image, OneCLI vault, Anthropic credential, service, first agent, optional channel wiring. On error, it offers Claude-assisted recovery and resumes where it stopped.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say 'setup', 'install', 'configure nanoclaw', or ask for first-time setup.

say_en.note: Claude will ask you to run bash nanoclaw.sh

say_en.text: I want to do first-time NanoClaw setup
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through the install script
